method: Sector score = average 5-pillar composite of that sector's book names; trend from this week's real session/weekly moves.

sectors.name: Financials
sectors.note: Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole lifted the 10-yr to ~4.72% - higher-for-longer rates support bank NII; JPM +1.0% Friday.

sectors.name: Semiconductors
sectors.note: Post-NVDA de-rating on rates and a margin/memory-cost worry (NVDA -4.6% Fri); memory (MU) held firm, WFE estimates raised.

sectors.name: Cybersecurity
sectors.note: High-multiple security de-rated on the yield spike; PANW -2.9%, CRWD -4.2%.

sectors.name: Consumer / LatAm
sectors.note: Split tape: MELI +1.8% led on a down day while NU -3.9% on the US-rate spike hitting EM/fintech.

sectors.name: Software / AI
sectors.note: Quality beat and led (MSFT +1.7%, GOOGL +1.7%, NOW +4.5%) while high-beta security fell - flight to quality within software.

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Brent -5% to ~89.31 and WTI to ~83.40 on easing Iran/Hormuz risk; energy among the weakest S&P sectors, though SLB bucked it +4.2%.

sectors.name: Industrials
sectors.note: Electrification names fell (ETN -3.2%) while aerospace held (GE flat) - rate-sensitivity split the group.

sectors.name: Healthcare
sectors.note: Mixed: ISRG +1.5% and defensives firmed, but LLY gave back ~5% as the mRNA-vaccine euphoria faded and rates bit.

sectors.name: Uranium & nuclear fuel
sectors.note: CCJ -5.9% back through $100 as the whole AI-power/nuclear complex sold off on rates.

sectors.name: AI power / nuclear
sectors.note: The most rate-sensitive basket: CEG -2.0%, VST -1.9% (new lows), GEV -4.4% as the 10-yr spiked to 4.72%.

sectors.name: Renewables
sectors.note: FSLR -2.7%; solar stayed out of favour amid rates and mixed energy-policy sentiment.

sectors.name: Space
sectors.note: RKLB -4.6%; speculative high-beta names sold first in the rate scare.
